name: v16.35.0
body:
## Breaking Changes
* Removes the "Print IRS 1099 Forms" button and its associated printing option from the "IRS 1099" report. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58992)

## Features
* Adds multi-select _Item_ and _Warehouse_ filters to the "Warehouse Wise Item Balance Age and Value" report, allowing users to compare multiple items and warehouses in one report. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59005)

## Bug Fixes
* Updates the "Stock Ledger" preview to show the actual _Outgoing Rate_ for outgoing entries in the company currency, while leaving it blank for incoming entries. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58883)
* Updates **Stock Entry** to allocate additional costs to incoming items when _Basic Amount_ is zero, using transfer quantities so inventory valuation and accounting entries use the same cost distribution. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58887)
* A **Stock Closing Entry** created after a previous one now reads the earlier **Stock Closing Balance** correctly. This prevents later closings from stopping with an error. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58854)
* Keeps a **Dunning** unresolved when the invoice amount is paid but its interest or fee remains outstanding, so the remaining amount can still be collected. Using "Create → Payment" on such a **Dunning** creates a **Payment Entry** for only the unpaid dunning amount, and cancelling that payment makes the dunning available for collection again. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58908)
* Uses the current _Confirm Before Resetting Posting Date_ setting from **Accounts Settings** when saving transactions with a different _Posting Date_, so updated settings take effect without reloading the session. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58918)
* Rejects disabled **Price List** values when saving or submitting buying and selling documents; linked returns can retain the price list from the original submitted document. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58901)
* Prevents a server error in **Inventory Dimension** when _Reference Document_ is empty; the form waits for the required document details before loading parent-field options and displays the standard required-field validation when saving. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58904)
* Updates **Sales Order** and **Purchase Order** to use the configured default _Price List_ when the customer or supplier changes, instead of retaining the previous party’s price list. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58913)
* Prevents saving an **Item** when _Has Batch No_, _Has Expiry Date_, and _Automatically Create New Batch_ are enabled but _Shelf Life In Days_ is zero or less. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58915)
* Counts holidays marked _Is Half Day_ as 0.5 days in **Holiday List** totals and updates the total when holidays are added, removed, or edited. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58902)
* Removes completely empty rows from _Delivery Stops_ when Delivery Notes are added to a **Delivery Trip**, while retaining partially filled rows. Missing _Address_ values now trigger the regular required-field validation instead of an address lookup error. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58921)
* Updates **Purchase Invoice** returns with _Update Stock_ disabled so _Received Qty_ and _Rejected Qty_ no longer count toward the returned quantity; _Qty_ still limits returns to the billed amount. Hides _Received Qty_, _Rejected Qty_, and _Warehouse Section_ for these invoices. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58929)
* Updates **Purchase Receipt** billing calculations to include rejected quantities in the billable amount, keeping the billed percentage from exceeding 100% when those quantities are invoiced. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58897)
* Prevents disabled _Price List_ values from being prefilled or selected for transactions, including Sales and Purchase Orders. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58931)
* Adds an email permission check when a **Customer** credit limit is crossed; the "Send Email" action appears only for users permitted to email that customer. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58938)
* Keeps each item's _Rate_ when items are fetched from a **Delivery Note** into a **Sales Invoice**, instead of applying one item's rate to other rows. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58944)
* Fixes selection of _Against Finished Good_ values on **Stock Entry** documents with the “Receive from Customer” purpose when the item is identified by its item code or row reference. Shows the item code instead of an internal row identifier for linked **Subcontracting Inward Order Item** records. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58951)
* Updates the "Material Requirements Planning" report to label monthly buckets with the corresponding demand month instead of the following month. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58970)
* Treats an empty _Cost Allocation Per_ value in **BOM** as zero during cost allocation, so saving the BOM shows the existing validation message instead of a server error. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58945)
* Replaces the server error from selecting "Transfer Materials" for a **Job Card** with no raw materials in **Workstation** with a message stating that there are no raw materials to transfer. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58947)
* Fixes an error that prevents opening a new **Work Order** when _Company_ is not set; default warehouses are now loaded only after a company is selected. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58971)
* Prevents the **Warehouse** hierarchy from being rebuilt when a parent warehouse has no matching stock account, avoiding unnecessary changes during stock account lookups. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58973)
* Updates **Asset** so changing _Asset Type_ recalculates whether _Purchase Receipt_ and _Purchase Invoice_ are required, preventing a mandatory-field error when those fields are not applicable. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58983)
* Excludes fully billed **Sales Order** records from the "Get Items From > Sales Order" picker and the "Create > Sales Invoice" action, including when an overbilling allowance is set, preventing **Sales Invoice** creation with no items. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58967)
* Adds a permission check before the payment ledger reposting process starts, preventing users without permission to submit the selected **Repost Payment Ledger** from running it. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58982)
* Adds permission checks when selecting invoices for **Invoice Discounting**; users must select a _Company_ and have permission to access both the company and the **Invoice Discounting** document. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58990)
* Fixes **BOM** cost allocation calculations by treating _Cost Allocation Per_ values as numbers when totaling percentages and calculating secondary-item costs. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58984)
* Lists billable **Sales Orders** from oldest to newest when adding items to a **Sales Invoice** through "Get Items From" → "Sales Order"; orders with the same _Transaction Date_ are sorted by `creation`. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59011)
* Carries the _Project_ from **Purchase Order** items into related **Subcontracting Order** items and copies the _Project_ and _Cost Center_ when creating **Purchase Receipt** items. Adds checks that the _Project_ matches across **Subcontracting Order** and **Subcontracting Receipt** documents. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59041)
* Uses the item's stock value at the **Stock Entry** posting date when recalculating costed-out rows, instead of a later value, so subsequent stock movements do not change historical row costs. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59048)
* Updates **Packing Slip** items to fetch the item master's name only when _Item Name_ is empty, so custom item names remain unchanged when the packing slip is saved. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/58943)
* Rejects **BOM** records that contain disabled **Item** records as the main item, a component, or a scrap item, including when the entries come from a copied or amended BOM. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59013)
* Updates **Asset** to populate the _Finance Books_ table when _Net Purchase Amount_ is entered after _Calculate Depreciation_ is enabled or an _Item_ is selected. It prevents delayed calculations based on earlier _Item_ or _Net Purchase Amount_ values from overwriting newer results. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59083)

**Authors**: @nabinhait, @ervishnucs, @Henil666, @krishna-254, @Shllokkk, @Pandiyan5273, @Sudharsanan11, @khushi8112, @diptanilsaha, @Afsalsyed, @mihir-kandoi
